issues.description: Symbol 'shared_data' visibility: The problem statement requires a globally visible variable named `shared_data` for tests. The template repository (template_repository/helloWorld.asm) does not define `shared_data` at all in the .data section. The solution repository (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm) defines `shared_data dd 100` but does not export it with a NASM `global shared_data` directive. This inconsistency will prevent automated tests or external linkers from finding the symbol and will block tests that rely on the symbol being globally visible, causing build/link or test failures and confusing students about the required symbol visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make `shared_data` consistently globally visible across template and solution. In the template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm) add a definition in the .data section, e.g. `shared_data dd 0` (or `dd 100` if you want the same initial value). In both template and solution files add the NASM export directive near the other globals (e.g. after `global main`) by inserting `global shared_data`. This ensures tests and linkers can locate the symbol without changing the pedagogical intent.
